acceptance_criteria.summary: Present title, artist, artwork, four large transports, Mic and Exit
Accurate Playing, Paused and No Track designs from service
Controls dispatch via one service-owned Player and Queue
TalkBack reading order and 100–200% readable text reflow
No typing, nested menus, long lists or distracting motion
Manual activation at approved entry points
Connected selected BT may suggest, never force enter
P1 hint cleanly removable without any P0 Driving loss
UI recreation returns to real service snapshot
Immediate exit to recorded manual-control origin
Road-attention notice with no guaranteed-safety claim
UI/a11y test coverage for Playing Paused No Track Exit
